item.title: Blit 1.0.7
item.description: Security fixes: copies and downloads never write through a symlink in the destination folder; Empty Trash on a drive only empties that drive's own Trash; downloaded files are quarantined, so macOS checks them when opened; a revoked host key is refused, and a server that offers a new kind of key gets a clear warning; Send to Blit lists every file it was given; and several crashes on malformed data from a server or a file are fixed.
